commit.message:
bip98: fix the third SKIP hash in the example proof

The example says the skipped hashes are 0x00..., 0x66... and 0x22...,
and traversal-example.dot has 0x22... as the SKIP branch of D, but the
base64 proof ended with 32 bytes of 0x44, which is one of the VERIFY
hashes. Re-encode the proof with 0x22... as the last hash. The length
(101 bytes) and the tree serialization are unchanged.

bip174: add PSBT_IN_P2C_TWEAK to the type registry

BIP-372 defines PSBT_IN_P2C_TWEAK = 0x19, but the per-input table in the
type registry goes from 0x18 straight to 0x1a.

bip375: sync vendored DLEQ code with BIP-374

bip-0375/deps/dleq.py is adapted from the BIP-374 reference code but
predates the change that treats the challenge e as a scalar (#2262).
Reduce the challenge hash mod n and reject proofs with e >= n, so the
copy used by the BIP-375 validator matches the current BIP-374
reference.

commit.message:
bip138: exclude roots exposed by another expression

A root selected through a derived xpub can also appear bare or as a
literal key. Once a spend reveals it, anyone could decrypt the backup.
Exclude such cases.
